NetworkHint: Open KittyClaw on your phone or another device using a code from your authenticator app. No password is required.
NetworkLocalSetup: Configure or reset access from localhost on this PC.
NetworkLoginHint: Enter the current six-digit code from your authenticator app.
NetworkInvalidCode: Invalid, expired or already used code. Wait for a new code and try again. After five failed attempts, wait one minute.
NetworkEnabled: Network access is enabled. Use one of these addresses on your phone.
NetworkRestart: Protection is configured. Restart KittyClaw to start the HTTPS network listener.
NetworkCertificate: The connection uses a certificate generated by this PC. On the first visit, verify and trust this certificate on your device. Your firewall must allow the displayed HTTPS port on your private network.
NetworkEnroll: In your authenticator app, add an account using this setup key (time-based, six digits, every 30 seconds), then enter its current code.
NetworkEnable: Validate code and enable network access
NetworkRecovery: If you lose your authenticator, open this page through localhost on this PC to disable access and associate a new app. Disabling access also revokes existing sessions.
